_description: Defines devices and languages for automated screenshot generation via UI tests

test._comment: Fast test configuration: 1 device × 1 language = 1 combination

devices.name: iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)
devices._comment: 13" display, captures at 2O64x2752, final output resized to 2048x2732

ipad-zh._comment: Focused iPad testing for Simplified Chinese

_notes: Use CONFIG=test or CONFIG=prod environment variable to select configuration
Default is 'prod' if CONFIG is not specified
Test config: 1 device × 1 language = 1 combination (fast testing)
Prod config: 2 devices × 5 languages = 10 combinations (full App Store)
Device names must match exact output of 'xcrun simctl list devices'
Short names are used in filename generation (max 10 chars)
Languages follow iOS locale format (ISO 639-1 + region)
